name: How does a site feasibility consultation differ from a general property inspection?

mainEntity.name: How does a site feasibility consultation differ from a general property inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: A site feasibility consultation focuses specifically on the suitability of a property for a proposed construction project, like a tiny home. It assesses factors such as zoning, utility access, and environmental impacts relative to your building plans. A general property inspection, conversely, typically evaluates the existing structures on a property for their condition, safety, and functionality. While both are important, their scope and objectives are distinct: one looks forward to new construction, the other at existing structures.
acceptedAnswer.description: A site feasibility consultation assesses land suitability for new construction, while a property inspection evaluates existing structures.
